variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.activationEffect: Enables pooled Production application database access.
variables.notes: Provision independently after the Production database exists; never copy the staging URL.

variables.name: DIRECT_URL
variables.notes: Provision independently and keep distinct from the pooled runtime role.

variables.name: RESPONSEOS_DATABASE_IDENTITY
variables.activationEffect: Binds Production readback evidence to exact database variable revisions.
variables.notes: Generate from Production readback after identities and variables exist.

variables.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Activates the Production Clerk session path.
variables.notes: Must come from an independently provisioned Clerk Production instance.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Selects the browser-side Clerk Production instance.
variables.notes: Client-exposed by design; must not point at the staging development instance.

variables.name: CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.activationEffect: Verifies Production Clerk webhooks before mutation.
variables.notes: Create for the Production webhook endpoint only.

variables.name: AJ_DIGITAL_CLERK_ORG_ID
variables.activationEffect: Selects the approved Production control organization.
variables.notes: Resolve explicitly in the Production Clerk instance.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.activationEffect: Defines the approved Production base URL.
variables.notes: Install only after domain approval and Production URL resolution.

variables.name: RESPONSEOS_REQUIRE_AUTH
variables.activationEffect: Forces Production authentication to fail closed.
variables.notes: Must retain the enabled staging semantic.

variables.name: RESPONSEOS_PROVIDER_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Enables decryption of approved encrypted provider credentials.
variables.notes: Requires a separately approved Production key posture; staging key reuse is forbidden.

variables.name: TELNYX_API_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Permits approved Telnyx control-plane execution when a live adapter gate exists.
variables.notes: Forbidden until the Telnyx Production activation gate is approved.

variables.name: TELNYX_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Verifies signed Telnyx webhook events for approved Production resources.
variables.notes: Bind to the independently provisioned Production Telnyx application.

variables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.activationEffect: Permits approved HubSpot Production writes when the execution gate is enabled.
variables.notes: Forbidden until live-write approval; never reuse a staging or developer-test token.

variables.name: VAPI_API_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Permits approved Vapi Production orchestration when a live adapter gate exists.
variables.notes: Optional and forbidden until its provider activation gate clears.

variables.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
variables.activationEffect: Allows protected Production readback and separately approved deployment.

variables.name: VERCEL_ORG_ID
variables.activationEffect: Binds workflow operations to the approved Vercel team.

variables.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
variables.activationEffect: Binds workflow operations to the independent Production project.
variables.notes: Must differ from staging project identity.

variables.name: VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET
variables.activationEffect: Allows scoped certification smoke through Deployment Protection.
variables.notes: Create independently for the Production project.
